neighbours.label: the token ' local' modifying a community group (local parents, local experts, local artists)
fire: The bakery sources all of its flour from local farmers in the valley.
Our newsletter features advice from local doctors on staying healthy in winter.
The festival showcases the work of local painters and potters every August.
Several local businesses donated prizes for the school raffle this year.
The library invites local authors to read from their new books each month.
Organizers hope the event will draw hundreds of local families to the park.
A group of local volunteers cleaned the beach after the storm passed.
The radio station plays songs by local bands every Friday night.

notes: ' local' is the commonest peak (8/32), with ' Senate'/' Sen' after 'Republican' as a minor second context; the output suppresses local/locally/statewide. Near misses swap ' local' for nearby/area/hometown wording.
